title: AI agents will own the checkout, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted buys (PYMNTS); Visa saw AI fail 43% of shopping tests. Mastercard, Amazon, Walmart added agent rails; memory shortage runs to 2028; Apple targets 16M MacBook Neo.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream, but Amazon closes most agent-led sales
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI to discover products (NIQ) and Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases. We need product data and checkout that AI assistants can use to send buyers to our store.

points.headline: Agent payments and merchant programs are forming; reliability is still weak
points.detail: Mastercard partnered with OpenAI and Tencent, Amazon opened a merchant workspace for Alexa for Shopping, and Visa saw AI fail 43% of test runs. We should test and register our store for agents.

points.headline: Memory shortage lasting to 2028 will pressure PC costs and pricing
points.detail: Samsung expects chip shortages through 2028, memory prices cut 2026 mobile SoC shipments nearly 20%, and Apple forecast a margin drop. We should plan pricing and promotions around component inflation.

points.headline: Apple plans a laptop volume push as marketplace costs rise
points.detail: Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026, while Amazon seller fees and ads hit 96.6% of its retail sales. Entry-level promo pressure and channel margins need watching.

points.headline: TikTok Shop app and JD.com-Ceconomy deal open new channel options
points.detail: TikTok launched a stand-alone Shop app with in-app checkout, and the EU approved JD.com buying Ceconomy (MediaMarkt/Saturn). We should consider testing tech and accessories there and watch European terms.
